title: team-review concurrency must queue runs in one repo-wide group
answers: team-review workflow cancelled queued run when label applied twice
why does team-review keep only one pending run
duplicate labels cancel the bot's reviewer assignment run
body:
Symptom: when the team-review label is applied twice quickly, one of the bot's review-assignment runs is dropped and the PR never gets its second run's result.
Root cause: .github/workflows/team-review.yml:concurrency kept only one pending run per group, so queued runs were cancelled.
Fix pattern: keep `cancel-in-progress: false` and add `queue: max` under the same concurrency block so pending runs are queued rather than dropped.
Constraints: keep the group repo-wide (`${{ github.workflow }}`), not per-PR, because every run rewrites the shared stats issue (#19428). Per-PR groups would let runs race on that issue. Changing the group key or the queue setting changes this guarantee.
applies: Editing or adding concurrency settings in .github/workflows/team-review.yml.
says: Rapidly applying the team review label drops reviewer assignment without processing the request.
Reviewer assignment bot fails to assign reviewers when labels are added in rapid succession.
Queue automated review runs so duplicate label triggers do not cancel pending assignments.
Why was automated reviewer assignment skipped on my pull request after re-labeling?
Prevent multiple team review label events from dropping automated review requests.

When the team-review label was applied twice quickly, keeping only one pending run per group cancelled queued runs and dropped review-assignment results. The concurrency group key must remain repository-wide (${{ github.workflow }}) rather than per-PR because every run rewrites shared statistics tracking issue #19428, which would race under per-PR groups.
